Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE DECISION TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- Automate the delivery of gigawatts. Every process that takes AI infrastructure from land to live compute becomes software: schedules, decisions, and todos generated from a live knowledge graph instead of chased by hand.

- Forward-deploy beside the experts. Product teams sit with quality managers, sourcing leads, and deployment engineers on factory floors and sites, and turn their judgment into systems that reach every unit.

- Deliver every supercomputer faster than the last. Dozens of concurrent projects feed one graph, so every lesson learned at one site becomes a preventive check at all of them.

ROLE SCOPE

- Build the schedule that runs the portfolio: one template schedule per building type, instantiated per project, with every activity tied to the materials it consumes, so need-by dates for switchgear, transformers, and cooling fall out of the critical path instead of a spreadsheet, and a slip in permitting reprices the procurement calendar the same hour.

- Turn the site into structured data: work packages, contractor field entries, rack placements, cable runs, and QA inspections land as records tied to the design revision they were built against, percent complete is computed from evidence rather than reported on a call, and the customer sees delivered against committed without anyone assembling a deck.

- Ship change orders as a workflow, not an email chain: scope, cost, and schedule impact drafted from the design delta, routed through legal, finance, and the general contractor with the approval trail attached, and the bill of materials and schedule updated the moment the order is signed.

- Make the design the source of truth: ingest building information models straight into the bill of materials with a reviewable diff on every revision, generate submittal requirements per spec section, and keep sites, buildings, and data halls as one canonical record that every downstream system reads instead of copies.

- Ship commissioning as software: test procedures generated per asset from the design revision across all five levels, results landing as evidence against the asset they tested, energization gates that check themselves, and handover that opens on proof instead of a signature.

title: Team Lead, Android Core Product - Malaga, Spain
description:
Remote
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
Over 50 million people use Speechify 's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading - PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites - into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify 's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.
Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting - Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.
Overview
Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.
This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own - that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.
We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.
What You'll Do

• Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team - from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight

• Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features

• Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval

• Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself

• Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through

• Keep the shared pieces in working order - tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear

• Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own

• Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out

• When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time

• Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out

• Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear

• Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless

• Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early

• Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team

• Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.
An Ideal Candidate Should Have

• 5+ years of software engineering experien

title: Founding Robot Operator, US
description:
Everyone should be able to afford a well-built home in a beautiful neighborhood. Our ambition is to help solve the housing crisis and bring beauty back to the places we live. We are developing robots that can make intricate, high-quality construction affordable at scale. We are hiring our founding Robot Operators in the United States, starting with our first pilot in San Antonio, Texas.

You will help bring a system already used on sites in the Netherlands and the UK to a new market. As one of our first US operators, you will help establish how we work on site and give our engineering team direct feedback from the field.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is hands-on construction work with robots. You will move bricks and mortar, keep the robots supplied, set up equipment and clean the site. You will also operate the robots using Atrium, our in-house software, and work with our engineers when something needs fixing.

No previous robotics or construction experience is required. We are looking for practical people with technical intuition, an eye for detail and the initiative to solve problems. We will train you to operate our systems. This is a full-time role. Training starts at our headquarters in Amsterdam, with costs covered by Monumental.

Our operators come from construction, retail, hospitality, events, farms, workshops and engineering. What they share is a preference for working with their hands and seeing the things they build.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Prepare construction projects: understand the build plan and assess site conditions.

- Place markers and take photos for 3D reconstruction.

- Set up and operate masonry robots using a laptop and our software.

- Carry and load bricks and mortar, move equipment and keep the work area safe and tidy.

- Help with site tasks such as cutting bricks, setting wall ties and pointing walls.

- Troubleshoot with our engineering and operations teams.

- Record problems and improvements so our engineers can develop the hardware and software.

- Work with the contractors and trades around you as the face of Monumental on site.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- A practical, technical mindset and a willingness to learn.

- Comfort with physical work outdoors, early starts and changing site conditions.

- Attention to detail: the quality of the finished wall matters.

- Initiative when something does not go to plan.

- A valid driver’s license and comfort driving to construction sites.

- Good spoken and written English for working with our team.

- Construction, maintenance or other hands-on experience is useful, but not required.

LOCATION

This is an on-site role in San Antonio, Texas, starting with our first US pilot. You need to be able to work on construction sites in the San Antonio area. This is not a remote role.

WHY MONUMENTAL?

You will be part of the team bringing our robots to US construction sites for the first time. The work combines physical building, technical problem-solving and direct collaboration with the people developing the robots. Your feedback will help shape the next deployment.

Learn more about Monumental https://www.monumental.co/about, Atrium https://www.monumental.co/atrium and life as a Robot Operator https://www.monumental.co/blog/the-best-product-job-isnt-in-engineering.

If you do not meet every line above but enjoy building things and solving practical problems, we would still like to hear from you.

title: PhD Position: World Models for Software Architecture Synthesis (Constructor Fabric)
description:
Supervisor: Prof. Dr. Alexander Tormasov

About the Position

Constructor Knowledge Labs (CKL), in collaboration with Constructor Technology, invites applications for a PhD position in machine learning for software engineering and formal methods, on the Constructor Fabric project.

Constructor Fabric turns a company's informal knowledge into production software through a pipeline of composable capability units called gears : requirements → architecture → product fit → framework (G1) → application → runtime. We are building a World Model over that pipeline - a model that does not just generate code, but predicts the consequences of an architectural decision: total cost of ownership, unintended side effects, latency and failure behaviour, and whether a proposed composition is even admissible.

The central object is not a digital twin of the application but its formal architectural skeleton : gear contracts (GearSpec), a typed attributed hypergraph of the application (AppGraph), a composition algebra that defines which assemblies are legal, and several semantic projections (types, protocols, resources, security) over which properties are proved, refuted by counterexample, or reported as an explainable gap . All of it is written in a domain-specific language whose syntax trees and graphs we keep in a projectional editor (JetBrains MPS) - so the DSL is not a convenience layer, it is the thing that defines the model's state space and the boundary of what the model is allowed to propose.

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

THE OPPORTUNITY:

The United States is home to many of the world's largest materials, chemicals, semiconductor and energy R&D organizations. As a Partnerships Manager, you'll be one of the first people to bring CuspAI to these teams.

- Help build the processes, materials and playbook that the wider team will use as we grow.

- A network among R&D and business leaders at US industrial companies.

- The ability to explain AI and computational concepts clearly to scientists and business leaders alike.

- Comfort with ambiguity, and the drive to build structure from scratch in a fast-growing startup.

- Willingness to travel regularly within the US and to Europe.

- An advanced degree in chemistry, materials science, physics, chemical engineering or a related field.

- Experience at a company working in materials informatics, scientific software or AI for R&D.

- Experience building a market or commercial function from the ground up.

LOCATION

This role is based in the United States, ideally near a major materials, chemicals or semiconductor hub. Expect regular travel to customer sites and probably to our offices in the UK and Eu

title: Assistant Lane Support SME - Remote
description:
Primary Mission:

The Assistant Lane Support Subject Matter Expert (SME) is an integral member of the West Virginia National Guard (WVNG) Ridge Runner Irregular Warfare Exercise (IWX) Program, responsible for supporting the planning, coordination, execution, and closeout of complex Special Operations Forces (SOF) training exercises. The position assists the Lane Support SME in coordinating logistics, manpower, resources, exercise infrastructure, and administrative requirements across assigned areas of operation.

The Assistant Lane Support SME must demonstrate strong organizational, logistical, asset deconfliction, and project management capabilities while supporting multiple exercises in various stages of development and execution. The position requires effective coordination with military personnel, Government agencies, civilian authorities, and domestic and international exercise participants in a dynamic, mission-driven environment.

Role and Responsibilities

• Provide operational, logistical, and administrative support to the WVNG Joint Staff Office, WVNG J37, WVNG J3 Joint Operations Center, and Ridge Runner Program in support of exercise planning, coordination, and execution.

• Assist the Lane Support SME with planning, development, coordination, and execution of Ridge Runner training activities, including Concept Development Conferences (CDC), Initial Planning Conferences (IPC), Mid Planning Conferences (MPC), Final Planning Conferences (FPC), and post-exercise closeout activities.

• Coordinate with domestic and foreign exercise participants, military organizations, Government agencies, and external stakeholders to synchronize exercise requirements, resources, schedules, and operational support.

• Support exercise lane development, site preparation, setup, execution, and recovery, including coordination with local business owners, municipal officials, and private landowners for access to facilities, infrastructure, and training locations through the Realistic Military Training (RMT) Packet process.

• Coordinate with federal, state, and local law enforcement agencies, emergency management organizations, and emergency medical services to support exercise integration, public safety, and operational requirements.

• Prepare and coordinate exercise notifications and required Memorandums of Understanding (MOUs) or Letters of Understanding (LOUs) with applicable jurisdictions, organizations, and property owners.

• Assist the Lane Support SME with exercise lane management, safety coordination, logistical support, personnel accountability, and resolution of operational or administrative issues during exercise execution.

• Support the coordination and delivery of Irregular Warfare training activities, instructional preparation, and exercise-related briefings in accordance with established Ridge Runner training objectives and program requirements.

• Perform administrative functions including event scheduling, calendar management, email and telephone correspondence, meeting coordination, note-taking, records maintenance, document organization, and tracking of assigned actions.

• Assist with coordination of foreign participant requirements, including foreign visit requests, installation access procedures, and communication with appropriate Government representatives when required.

• Maintain effective communication with Ridge Runner leadership, the Lane Support SME, exercise controllers, and participating organizations to identify emerging requirements, resolve coordination issues, and ensure continuity of exercise support.

Supervisory Responsibilities

• None

•
Special Operations Experience: Minimum five (5) years of operational experience as an operator within a U.S. Special Operations organization, including USASOC, MARSOC, or NSWDG, with at least three (3) years of administrative or operational support to senior leaders in high-tempo or mission-driven environments.

You will join our European Strategic Sourcing Team, which buys the ingredients and products behind millions of HelloFresh meals across multiple markets. Our ambitious team is growing and we have several junior roles open within the Procurement team, each with its own focus.

You don’t need to pick a specific position upfront. During the process, we’ll get to know your strengths and interests and discuss together where you’d fit best. Whichever role you take, you’ll learn how international procurement works from start to finish and help make sure our customers get high-quality products at the right cost, every week.

Please note: For junior positions, we are unable to offer visa or work permit sponsorship, either now or in the future. To be considered, you must already have the legal right to work in your preferred location.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

• Support procurement strategies and plans across our European markets, working closely with experienced colleagues in the team.

• Analyse supplier offers, cost data and market prices to build cost models and spot savings opportunities.

• Monitor market trends and supply risks, using data and Generative AI tools to support pricing forecasts and decisions.

• Identify and assess suppliers, prepare negotiations and take ownership of selected suppliers as you gain experience.

• Collaborate with product, culinary, food safety and quality, and operations teams to bring new products to our customers on time.

• Contribute to cross-functional procurement projects and keep local and global stakeholders up to date on progress.

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

• A bachelor’s or master’s degree, for example in business, supply chain, engineering, or food science.

• Up to 2 years of experience in procurement, supply chain or a related field. Exposure to the food industry is a plus.

• Strong analytical skills and confidence working with data in Excel or Google Sheets.

• Clear communication skills and the ability to build relationships with suppliers and colleagues across teams, countries and functions.

• A proactive, organised mindset. You take initiative and enjoy learning quickly in a fast-moving environment.

• Excellent English. Another European language is a plus, as is a willingness to travel occasionally within Europe.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. There are many different ways of developing skills, and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What we offer: The Toppings

Our benefits vary by country. Here is a taste of what you can expect:

• Tasty discounts : generous discounts on HelloFresh and our other brands, plus savings with partner brands.

• Learning & growth : internal training, and mentoring opportunities

• Flexibility : a hybrid working setup

• A warm welcome : an onboarding program and a dedicated manager

• Wellbeing : discounted fitness memberships and access to mental health and mindfulness apps.

• Financial security : a company pension scheme and commuting support, depending on your location.

• Great people : team events, Friday drinks and a lively office culture.

Are you the missing ingredient? If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we’d be excited to hear from you. We aim to review your profile and respond within 5 business days.

title: Senior Client Solutions Manager, Beauty - Influencer Marketing (Remote - US, EST hours)
description:
ABOUT KYRA

Our platform manages the full lifecycle - creator discovery, campaign management, content review, payments, analytics, and AI-powered intelligence across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.

You’ll manage a portfolio of brand accounts.

🎯 Lead the Relationship

Own client relationships across launches, seasonal campaigns, and always-on programs. Multi-thread across teams. Build trust. Have direct conversations when performance needs to improve.

Translate data into clear, actionable plans. Present performance against KPIs (engagement, EMV, sales lift, affiliate impact) and explain what it means.

Manage timelines, scopes, budgets, and execution across seeding, paid, and integrated campaigns. Keep work on-brand, on-time, and within margin.

Manage renewal timelines. Identify upsell opportunities. Drive Net Revenue Retention. Be able to speak confidently about account growth with real numbers.

💾 Use Data to Improve What’s Next
Forecast performance. Optimize mid-campaign. Apply learnings to the next program. Reporting informs decisions - it’s not a recap.

🛡️ Keep the System Tight
Keep tracking clean. Watch team capacity. Fix what’s inefficient. Make sure client feedback doesn’t get lost.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

We’re looking for someone who has:

- Beauty Industry Background: Previous experience at a beauty brand, beauty retailer, or agency focused on beauty clients

- 4-6+ years in influencer or creator marketing

- Strong hands-on campaign experience, with real fluency in Meta and TikTok

- Clear track record of account growth and retention - bring numbers

- Experience measured against revenue, retention, or NRR KPIs

- Leadership experience (running 1:1s, managing workload, supporting team performance)
AI-native - integrating AI tools into your day-to-day work to drive faster execution, better insight, and smarter workflows.

- Beauty experience is a plus

- You should be commercially sharp, operationally reliable, and able to speak confidently about the revenue impact of the accounts you’ve managed.

TRAITS THAT MATTER

Curious. Commercially aware. Direct. Adaptable. Strong at building trust. Open to feedback. You don’t avoid hard conversations. You don’t wait for issues to escalate. You don’t need constant direction.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

6 months in: renewals are planned early, NRR targets are on track, expansion opportunities are clearly mapped, delivery runs smoothly, and leadership trusts your forecast.

BENEFITS

🌎 We’re a remote-first team, giving you the flexibility to work from wherever you do your best work
🌴 Annual Time Off: 25 days PTO + bank holidays, 4 company-wide days off (Kyra Days), 3 wellness days, and paid sick leave each year
📚 Growth: Annual Learning & Development budget to invest in your skills.
💰 Rewards: Annual bonus scheme to recognise great work
🩺 Healthcare coverage for US-based team members

AI is core to how we operate. Use it to elevate your work. But everything in your application should reflect your own judgement and experience.

💟 Support

If you have a condition or require an adjustment to our interview process - please let us know so we can make adjustments to support you. Please note that when you submit an application or resume, your data will be processed in line with our privacy policy https://www.bamboohr.com/legal

At Kodesage , you'll have freedom and flexibility in a passionate, seasoned team. We're looking for people who thrive on ownership and believe the best ideas win. If you're ready to make a real impact in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, we'd love to hear from you!

• Win our first US enterprise customers for Oracle Forms migration and production support

• Own the full sales cycle, from qualified lead to signed contract

• Build the US pipeline and sales playbook with marketing, partners and our founders

• Work with Presales and Forward Deployed Engineers to grow each account after the first deal

What you bring

• You've sold or delivered Oracle projects, especially Oracle Forms, APEX or EBS. That's our one non-negotiable, and SaaS experience can't replace it

Nice to have

• Sold migration, modernization or professional services into enterprises

• Ownership: you run your deals end to end without needing to be managed

description:
This is a remote position.

About India Market Entry (IME):

India Market Entry (IME) is a boutique market-entry consultancy helping international education companies establish and scale in India. Headquartered in Faridabad, we operate across 9 Indian cities with a 68-member team, 35+ global education clients, and a 150+ reseller network. Our clients include Save My Exams, Express Publishing, World Book, Hamilton House, Mathspace, EdAlive, and more.We are expanding our marketing team with new and Lead-generation Specialist (LGS) roles focused on driving high-quality lead qualification and sales conversions.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Every interactive flat panel installed in an Indian classroom and every tablet handed out under a 1:1 state programme needs content to demonstrate value. That is the opportunity you work. You speak with channel heads and product managers at Promethean, BenQ, Samsung Flip, ViewSonic, Globus Infocom, Lenovo, HP, Dell, Acer, and the ~150 hardware distributors that move these devices into Indian schools. You qualify their content-gap on the device, identify which IME products (EdAlive, World Book, Hamilton House, Tilli Kids, Mathspace, IDL Group) could ride on their hardware, and hand off bundle-fit meetings to the LSM team. This is hardware-channel language: margin, pull-through, sell-in, sell-out, ASP. Not edtech language.

Responsibilities:

• Build and maintain three sub-lists: IFP manufacturers (~25), tablet and laptop OEMs (~15), education-hardware distributors (~150).

• Run multi-touch outbound sequences (LinkedIn + email primary, phone secondary) to channel heads, India-business heads, and product managers.

• Reach 50-70 channel-head conversations per month across the three sub-segments.

• Apply the hardware-variant of the qualifying questionnaire - device type, target segment, content-gap, bundling history.

• Build a bundle-fit recommendation per qualified prospect - which 1-3 IME products ride well on this hardware.

• Coordinate with Marketing for device-mockup collateral when LSM demos are scheduled.

• Maintain quarterly cadence with dormant hardware contacts - cycles run 60-180 days.

• Coordinate event-driven follow-ups around InfoComm India, BETT India, IFP brand partner meets, and state government procurement events..

Requirements

•
Skills Required:

• 4-6 years of B2B hardware-channel sales, device-distribution, or technology-bundle sales.

• Working comfort with hardware-channel vocabulary - margin, pull-through, sell-in, sell-out, bundle-economics, ASP.

• Familiarity with the Indian education-hardware landscape - IFP brands, tablet/laptop OEMs, distribution channel structure.

• Strong written outreach for LinkedIn and email - channel heads ignore generic templates.

• Patience for long cycles; hardware bundle deals take 60-180 days from first contact.

• Prior experience at an IFP brand, a tablet/laptop OEM, or in their education-channel team.

• Awareness of state-government education-procurement cycles (Rajasthan, UP, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, etc.) that drive school-hardware volume.

• Working understanding of EdTech content licensing economics (most candidates will lack this - it's a strong plus)

Benefits
Benefits Offered:

• Competitive fixed plus performance-linked incentive, paid monthly.

• Direct exposure to senior hardware-channel leadership across India's biggest device brands.

• Cohort learning with extended 90-day ramp.

• Path to Senior ISM, Cohort Lead, or hardware-vertical LSM / strategy roles.

title: Delivery Operations Analyst
description:

Role Summary

We seek a highly organized, automation-minded Delivery Operations Analyst to connect GTM and Delivery Engineering teams under a unified operational system. Core duties include owning operational processes, data quality, and automation that move customer opportunities from GTM brief through commercial approval to delivery assignment. Maintain accurate data across Salesforce and Mission Control to support delivery execution.

A core expectation is to identify, design, implement, and continuously improve automation across the GTM-to-Delivery workflow(affectionately called Deal Desk, using workflow automation, North, and other appropriate tools. You will own automation outcomes end-to-end, from identifying manual inefficiencies through implementation, testing, monitoring, and iteration.

The ideal candidate combines operational rigor with a systems mindset, proactively looking for ways to eliminate repetitive work, improve data quality, reduce coordination overhead, and build scalable processes.

Key Responsibilities

- Oversee the operational process for new customer briefs submitted by GTM to Deal Desk; ensure required information and proper routing for approval.

- Coordinate the transition from commercial approval to the Engineering Program Manager for delivery team assignment.

- Track opportunities through pre-delivery stages, identifying actions, blockers, and missing information.

- Ensure clear, timely handoffs between GTM, Deal Desk, and EPM.

- Maintain accurate, timely data from the Deal Desk process; keep Salesforce and Mission Control updated with customer, opportunity, commercial, and delivery details.

- Establish standards for data entry, documentation, and operational hygiene.

- Develop and maintain reporting on Deal Desk volume, pipeline progression, approvals, delivery assignments, and operational metrics.

title: Head of Investor Relations
description:
We are hiring a Head of Investor Relations to lead the team that runs our investor network.
Pairs is a vetted private capital network. We put break-out founders in front of the family offices, VCs and strategic investors who fit them, and our team runs the investor relations work around every introduction. We are paid by the founder for our work, never by the round. Investors are members of the network and pay nothing. We are a small, senior team, profitable and self-funded.
The role
This is a leadership seat. You run the IR team: around six direct reports, the associates who each hold a book of members and clients. You report directly to the two co-founders.
Your job is to make that team excellent. You hire well, set a clear bar, run the weekly rhythm, coach every associate on their calls and pitches, and have the hard conversation early when someone is off track. The team’s results are your results.
Founders work with us for our investor network. Members read what we send because it fits what they told us. Through your team, you own that network and keep every relationship getting stronger month after month. You still take the mandate calls with our most senior family offices, because a leader who stays close to the work coaches it better.
What you will own

• The IR team: around six direct reports. Hiring, onboarding, weekly 1:1s, coaching, performance, and a clear bar for what good looks like.

• The team’s rhythm: a weekly kickoff, a weekly review of every win and loss, and a team that runs on its own when you are not in the room.

• The health of the investor network: more active members every month, and every member getting deals that fit their thesis at the pace they asked for.

• Pitch quality: every introduction your team sends is one you would put your own name on.

• A weekly read on the numbers to the co-founders: mandate calls, activations, pitches, founder calls and referrals.

• Senior mandate calls with family offices and strategic investors, including new regions.

• Close work with our client success team, so every client’s raise keeps moving.

You are a fit if you

• Have run a team before, ideally around six direct reports, and can show what they achieved under you and who you grew.

• Have hired, coached and, when needed, let go of people, and held a team to a standard without doing their work for them.

• Have 6 or more years on the investment side of a family office, VC or growth fund, or in capital raising for private companies.

• Hold real, current relationships with family offices, and know what they ask before they take a founder call.

• Write a two-line pitch an investor reads to the end.

• Run on systems: CRM discipline, a clear weekly rhythm, nothing left in your head.

• Treat discretion as a reflex: founders’ numbers and members’ names stay confidential.

• Work like it is 2026: AI tooling runs the admin so your hours go to people.

What we offer
US$200K to US$300K total compensation. Fully remote, with a few hours of overlap with US Eastern time. A seat reporting directly to both co-founders, a team to lead, and a network that grows with every month you put into it.
How to apply: hit apply, which takes you to a short application form. We read every application. Please do not name investors or companies from past roles anywhere in it.
Compensation Range: $200K - $300K

title: Manager, Software Engineering - Cloud infrastructure
description:
About Pyka
Pyka’s goal is to provide society with a new form of safe, clean, and cost-effective transportation enabled by autonomous electric aviation.
To get there, we’re taking a different approach than most. We're applying our technologies to every industry where autonomous electric aircraft can be useful, starting with the highest value and most dangerous jobs. In doing so, we're building game-changing products manufactured at scale, while perfecting the safety, reliability, and capabilities of our autonomy engine and electric propulsion systems. 
We design, develop and manufacture an ecosystem of technologies including proprietary flight control software, avionics, high power density motors, motor controllers, batteries, and custom carbon-fiber composite airframes.
Today, we supply autonomous electric aircraft for cargo transport and crop protection to real-world customers across four separate continents and have secured industry-first regulatory approvals from the FAA. Our cargo aircraft enables remote connectivity, enhances express delivery networks, and ensures fast and reliable shipping of critical supplies to areas in need. Our crop protection aircraft offers agricultural services providers and farmers an autonomous tool to make aerial application safer, more precise, and less harmful to surrounding environments. Both vehicles are highly economical to operate, easy to deploy, and significantly reduce CO2 emissions in their respective industries. 
What you work on at Pyka makes people’s lives better now and brings the future of electric aviation one step closer each day. 

Role Overview
Pyka is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to be the software owner of our Dropship and Cargo programs. The software problems in these programs span the stack: path planning over long ranges, controls for a new airframe, integration of new sensors, engine control and state-of-charge management on a hybrid powertrain, and incorporating weather into how a mission is planned and flown. You will be responsible for the software behavior of these aircraft as a whole - what it needs to do, how the pieces fit together, and whether it is ready to fly - and you will be the engineer the Dropship team comes to when software is the open question on their side.
 
Some of the current and future projects you will likely contribute to include:
Path planning for long-range cargo missions that accounts for energy state, winds aloft, and weather along the route
Energy management on a hybrid powertrain: engine control, state-of-charge policy, and how the aircraft trades power against range, payload, and reserve
Flight controls and handling for a new airframe, from simulation through flight test
Integrating new sensors and payload systems, and defining the software needs before the hardware is fixed
Turning operational feedback from cargo flights into requirements for the next iteration of the aircraft
Defining what mission planning and ground tools need to expose to operators flying these aircraft

Export Control Requirements
This position requires access to technology, software and other information that is subject to governmental access control restrictions, due to export controls.  Employment in this position is conditioned on the continued availability of government authorization to authorize release of such items, to the extent required, including without limitation an export license, or other documentation required to establish authorization to receive access to such items. 
Company may delay commencement of employment, rescind an offer of employment, terminate employment, and/or may modify job responsibilities, compensation, benefits, and/or access to Company facilities and information systems, as Company deems appropriate, in order to ensure compliance with applicable government access control restrictions.

Som Senior Search Specialist hos WPP Media vil du jobbe med spennende merkevarer og avanserte verktøy i et dynamisk og resultatorientert team. Hos oss vil du få en nøkkelrolle i å utvikle og optimalisere søkestrategier, kombinere data og kreativitet, løfte våre kunders synlighet og konvertering til nye høyder, og være en del av et miljø som alltid er i bevegelse.

Om WPP Media

WPP Media er medieenheten til WPP og består av merkevarene EssenceMediacom, Mindshare, Wavemaker og Choreograph. I en verden der media er overalt og i konstant endring, samler vi de beste menneskene, plattformene og partnerne for å skape ubegrensede muligheter for vekst. For mer informasjon, besøk nordics.wppmedia.com .

Stillingsbeskrivelse og ansvarsområder

Hvem er du?

Vi ser etter deg som har minimum 3 års erfaring med betalt søkt fra byrå eller mediesiden, og brenner for søkemotormarkedsføring. Du er teknisk og kommersielt anlagt, og evner å gå fra data til innsikt, strategi og handling.
Du vil i samarbeid med andre spesialister være en drivende kraft i å definere fremtidens digitale markedsstrategier, med særlig søkelys på målgrupper, data og teknologi. Du bygger sterke relasjoner, evner å undervise og veilede, og er trygg i kundefront.

 
Dine ansvarsområder:

• Sette opp, optimalisere og rapportere på Betalt søk kampanjer for maksimal ROI og kundens KPI-er.

• Teste, samle inn og analysere data for å identifisere trender og innsikt, og omdanne dette til strategier med høy impact.

• Administrere kampanjebudsjetter, overvåke forbruk og lønnsomhet, og identifisere vekstpotensial (new biz) og gi proaktive optimaliseringsanbefalinger.

• Representere fagområdet lokalt, nordisk og globalt i kunde- og interne møter.

• Samarbeide tett med partnere og teknologiløsninger, dele kunnskap og bidra til å øke teamets kompetanse innen Betalt Søk.

• Delta i pitcharbeid og innovative prosjekter relatert til Betalt Søk.

Dine kvalifikasjoner: 

• 3-5 års erfaring med Google Ads og Google Analytics.

• Erfaring med eller kjennskap til Bid Management Tools, Generativ Ai og ulike analyseverktøy.

• Evne til å kommunisere og iverksette komplekse segmenterings- og kommunikasjonsstrategier i søkemotorene Google og Bing.

• Analytisk, strukturert og detaljorientert.

• Nysgjerrig og proaktiv.

• Gode presentasjonsevner og flytende norsk og engelsk, både skriftlig og muntlig.

• Kjennskap til scripts, SEO og CRO er fordelaktig.

• Erfaring fra andre mediekanaler for å forstå synergieffekter er en sterk fordel.

 
Hva kan du forvente?

• En spennende hverdag med utfordrende oppgaver og stor påvirkningskraft.

• Gode karrieremuligheter i et internasjonalt selskap med sterke merkevarer.

• Et sosialt arbeidsmiljø med stor takhøyde og fokus på kompetansedeling og åpen kommunikasjon.

• Gode forsikrings- og pensjonsordninger.

• Sentral beliggenhet i Oslo.

 

Send inn din søknad og fortell oss hvorfor du er den rette for denne rollen!
Søknadsfrist er 15. november, men vi behandler søknader fortløpende.

Conduct preliminary reviews of interview briefs, publicity materials and correspondence, coordinating review and approval by the relevant functions before release.

•
Deliver proactive executive support: Manage the CEO’s calendar, travel, meeting logistics and expenses, aligning time allocation with priorities and anticipating scheduling conflicts and preparation needs.

•
Improve CEO office workflows: Establish practical systems for briefing preparation, information management, project tracking and follow-up. Use approved AI and automation tools to improve efficiency while protecting confidential information and verifying outputs.

 

What We Look For In You 

•
Demonstrated experience supporting senior executives and coordinating complex meetings or cross-functional initiatives in a fast-paced, international environment.

•
Strong business judgement and prioritisation skills, with the ability to distinguish routine coordination from matters requiring the CEO’s attention.

•
Excellent written communication and information synthesis skills; able to turn complex or fragmented inputs into concise, accurate briefings.

title: Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
About us

Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.

That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close.

We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world.

If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what's broken - you'll find people here who work exactly in the same way. And together, you'll build something worth being proud of.

What you'll be doing

As our Talent Acquisition Partner, you'll play a key role in fuelling Satispay's growth by scaling the teams who drive our revenue, build our product, and protect our business.

Here's what your day-to-day will look like:

- Own end-to-end recruiting - manage the full cycle for multiple roles, from sourcing to offer, independently

- Build active pipelines - proactively source candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, direct outreach, and other channels - not just wait for inbound applications

- Manage the ATS - keep candidate data, pipeline stages, and communications accurate and up to date in our Applicant Tracking System (Ashby) at all times

- Partner with hiring managers - coordinate interviews, manage stakeholder expectations, and answer daily operational questions on your open roles

- Track and report on metrics - monitor funnel conversion, time to hire, and offer acceptance rate, pulling reports autonomously from the ATS

- Drive employer branding initiatives - represent Satispay at career fairs, networking events, and industry conferences to promote our employer brand

- Ensure top-notch candidate experience - balance high-volume hiring with a consistently exceptional and engaging recruiting process for all candidates

Who we're looking for

This role needs someone who gets things done - proactively sourcing candidates, keeping the pipeline moving, and managing stakeholders without constant guidance.

- High-volume recruiting experience - 1 year of previous experience in a fast-paced in-house or agency environment with demonstrable output

- Hands-on sourcing skills - strong LinkedIn Recruiter proficiency and ability to generate leads through multiple channels proactively

- ATS autonomy - comfortable managing end-to-end candidate flow independently, regardless of which ATS you've used

- Knowledge of core Talent metrics - funnel conversion, time to hire, offer acceptance rate - and ability to pull reports directly from an ATS without support

- Stakeholder management experience - previous exposure to hiring managers or clients, including handling ongoing demand and daily questions on recruiting activity

Job Summary
Granicus serves more than 7,000 public-sector agencies and powers approximately 30 billion digital interactions annually. Within the Office of the CTO, we operate an AI-native software development lifecycle: a production engineering model in which autonomous agents perform high-confidence implementation work and senior engineers orchestrate, review, and own the outcome. The model is established and operating; we are scaling it across additional delivery teams.
This role joins one of those teams. Our engineering standards are calibrated to the practices used by leading software and AI organizations - generator-verifier architecture , eval-driven development , staged deployment , and high-volume autonomous pull-request pipelines - operated within a FedRAMP-authorized environment. We are hiring practitioners who will set and uphold these standards, not engineers who simply use AI tooling.
Operating constraints (non-negotiable): agents execute only within branches; all agent-generated code passes senior human review before merging to production; autonomous execution is a force multiplier and does not transfer accountability away from the responsible engineer. Compliance obligations - NIST 800-53 Rev 5, WCAG, SOC 2, and applicable FedRAMP authorizations - are treated as engineering requirements and a source of competitive advantage.
Why this role exists
High-volume autonomous agent pipelines are straightforward to demonstrate and difficult to operate safely, performantly, and auditably at scale. This role owns that problem. It is responsible for the generator-verifier architecture, agent orchestration patterns, the eval-driven development discipline, and a continuous integration and delivery system engineered for a high volume of autonomous agent pull requests - all within a security boundary that keeps model inference inside the VPC (AWS Bedrock) and sandboxes agent actions (WASM-isolated runtime with encrypted credential storage).
